evidence.detail: normalize() calls titlecase.titlecase() which capitalizes letters after hyphens non-uniformly (treating 'a' as an article, so 'a-l-l' → 'a-L-L' while 'o-o-p-s' → 'O-O-P-S')
WHITELIST already used for exactly this pattern — whitelisted names bypass titlecase normalization and are returned as-is
whitelisted() check: if name starts with a WHITELIST entry, the original name is returned immediately before any titlecase transform

triage.fix_sketch: Add 'o-o-p-s a-l-l' to WHITELIST in decksite/deck_name.py (one line). For a more general fix, add a step in normalize() that detects all-single-letter hyphenated patterns (regex like `^([a-z]-)+[a-z]( ([a-z]-)+[a-z])*$`) and skips titlecase for them; add a test in deck_name_test.py.
triage.notes: Whitelist approach is a 1-line fix identical in style to the existing 'B U R N' and 'G L I M P S E' entries; a general regex fix is ~10 lines but avoids per-name whitelisting.
